articles.title: Powerful Earthquake Strikes Japan's Kumamoto, Killing People and Causing Shopping Mall Explosion
articles.summary: A strong earthquake measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale struck Kumamoto Prefecture in southern Japan on Tuesday afternoon. The tremor was very shallow, which made it much more powerful at ground level. Shortly after shaking stopped, a large shopping mall called AEON Mall in Kashima Town exploded violently, shocking people across the country. The mall's president confirmed that the blast killed three employees, left one person with no heartbeat, and left three others missing. Emergency workers are still searching for survivors. Around 200 people have reportedly been injured across the wider Kumamoto region.

lv1: What was the size of the earthquake that hit Kumamoto, Japan? (日本熊本縣發生的地震有多大？)
What happened to the AEON Mall shopping centre after the earthquake? (地震後，永旺夢樂城購物中心發生了什麼事？)
lv2: Why does a shallow earthquake cause more damage than a deep one? (為什麼淺層地震比深層地震造成更大的破壞？)
Why is it important for shopping malls to have emergency safety plans in case of earthquakes? (為什麼購物中心需要有應對地震的緊急安全計劃？)
lv3: Japan experiences many earthquakes every year. Should cities in earthquake-prone areas be built differently to reduce deaths and injuries? What changes would you suggest? (日本每年都發生很多地震。地震多發地區的城市是否應該以不同方式建造，以減少傷亡？你有什麼建議？)
After a disaster like an earthquake, who should be responsible for helping survivors — the government, private companies, or the community? Why? (在地震等災難發生後，誰應該負責幫助生還者——政府、私人企業還是社區？為什麼？)

articles.title: South Korea Opens Secret Files from 1990s Nuclear Talks with North Korea
articles.summary: South Korea's government has made public a new batch of historical records relating to nuclear discussions it held with North Korea during the 1990s. The documents reveal how deeply divided the two sides were during those early negotiations. Teams from both countries, led by their respective prime ministers at the time, held several rounds of talks. The release of these files gives the public a rare look at how difficult it has always been to discuss North Korea's nuclear programme. Historians and researchers say the records offer valuable lessons about diplomacy between the two Koreas.

lv1: Which two countries held nuclear talks that are described in the newly released documents? (新公開文件描述的是哪兩個國家之間的核談判？)
When did these nuclear talks between the two Koreas take place? (兩韓之間的核談判是在什麼時候舉行的？)
lv2: Why do governments sometimes keep important historical documents secret for many years before releasing them to the public? (為什麼政府有時會將重要的歷史文件保密多年才對外公開？)
How can learning about past diplomatic talks help countries solve problems today? (了解過去的外交談判，如何幫助各國解決今天的問題？)
lv3: Nuclear weapons are considered one of the world's most serious threats. Do you think international negotiations and diplomacy alone can make the world safer, or are other solutions needed? (核武器被視為全球最嚴重的威脅之一。你認為僅靠國際談判和外交手段能讓世界更安全嗎，還是需要其他解決方案？)

Some people believe countries should never have nuclear weapons, while others think they provide safety through deterrence. Which view do you agree with more, and why? (有些人認為任何國家都不應擁有核武器，另一些人則認為核武器通過威懾提供安全保障。你更同意哪種觀點？為什麼？)

articles.title: 立法會審議北部都會區發展條例草案　議員關注招商引資條文不足
articles.summary: 立法會法案委員會昨日審議《北部都會區發展條例草案》，多名議員表示關注草案中有關北部都會區吸引企業及投資者進駐的條文內容不夠清晰。北部都會區是香港政府的重大發展計劃，旨在把新界北部一帶發展成集住宅、商業及創新科技於一身的新市鎮。議員認為，條例草案應更明確訂明招商引資的機制，確保計劃能夠順利推展，帶動香港長遠發展。

lv1: 立法會昨日審議的條例草案與香港哪個地區的發展有關？
議員對條例草案有什麼主要關注？
lv2: 北部都會區的發展計劃對香港市民的日常生活可能帶來哪些改變？
為什麼吸引企業和投資者進入新發展區對香港的經濟發展很重要？
lv3: 大型城市發展計劃有時會改變原有的自然環境和社區面貌。你認為發展與保育之間應如何取得平衡？
北部都會區靠近中國內地邊境。你認為這種地理位置對香港的發展是優勢還是挑戰？請解釋你的看法。

articles.title: 葵涌廣場童黨疑滋擾商戶　警方拘捕5名青年男子
articles.summary: 警方表示，近期接獲投訴指葵涌廣場有青少年群體聚集，並疑似騷擾商戶及市民。警方對此高度關注，安排軍裝及便衣人員加強該區巡邏，並蒐集相關情報。上周一，警方拘捕了5名年齡介乎18至21歲的本地男子，涉嫌以言語恐嚇商戶。事件令各界關注青少年在公共場所的行為問題，以及商場保安措施是否足夠。

lv1: 警方在葵涌廣場拘捕了多少名男子？
被捕男子被懷疑犯了什麼罪？
lv2: 為什麼青少年在公共場所的行為問題需要社會各界共同關注，而不只是警方負責？
商場可以採取哪些措施，防止類似的滋擾事件再次發生？
lv3: 有人認為青少年犯罪問題反映社會教育和家庭支援不足，而非個人品德問題。你同意這個觀點嗎？為什麼？
執法機關在處理青少年違規行為時，應側重懲罰還是教育輔導？兩種方式各有什麼利弊？
